metadata.description: Serialization of hydra.markdown documents to Markdown text

literal.string: Render a single Block to its Markdown text form
Render a list of Blocks, joined by a blank line
Render a CodeBlock as a fenced code block, with the language tag on the opening fence if present
Render a Document as its complete Markdown text, an H1 title followed by its blocks
Render a Heading, prefixing its inline content with the appropriate number of `#` characters
Render a single Inline to its Markdown text form
Render a list of Inlines, concatenated with no separator
Render a Link in the standard `[text](target)` form
Render a List as bulleted (`-`) or numbered (`1.`, `2.`, ...) lines, one per item; item content is joined with a blank line for items spanning multiple blocks
Render a Table in GitHub-flavored Markdown pipe-table form, with a `---` separator row after the header
Render a TableRow as a pipe-delimited line
